name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 4 visits over 23 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 23 hours starting 2025-05-13, at wavelengths from 1.69 to 4.83 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
